CS2 archetypes, then the operator's 2026-11 damage pass (pistols ~-30%, rifles ~-15%, SMG +15%: no pistol-round one-taps, no rifle one-tap through a helmet); TestBalanceBands fails when the data leaves a band. Every weapon needs bands.
